name: SOC 2 Type II
scopeNote: SOC 2 evaluates the design and operating effectiveness of controls against the Trust Services Criteria. Most Common Criteria (CC1–CC5, CC7.3–CC7.5, CC9) are governance, risk, and operational controls evidenced by policy and process, not code. SAST/SCA provides direct evidence primarily for the logical-access (CC6) and change/vulnerability-management (CC7.1, CC8.1) criteria.

controls.title: Demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values
controls.summary: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
implementationChecklist: Code of conduct and ethics reporting

controls.title: Board independence and oversight
controls.summary: The board of directors exercises oversight of the development and performance of internal control.

controls.title: Establish structure, authority, and responsibility
controls.summary: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities.

controls.title: Commitment to competence
controls.summary: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.

controls.title: Enforce accountability
controls.summary: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

controls.title: Use relevant, quality information
controls.summary: The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support internal control.

controls.title: Communicate internally
controls.summary: The entity internally communicates information necessary to support internal control.

controls.title: Communicate externally
controls.summary: The entity communicates with external parties regarding matters affecting internal control.

controls.title: Specify objectives to identify and assess risk
controls.summary: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to enable identification and assessment of risks.

controls.title: Identify and analyze risk, including vulnerabilities
controls.summary: The entity identifies risks, including from vulnerabilities in systems, and analyzes them as a basis for management.
evidenceExamples: Vulnerability findings feeding the risk assessment

controls.title: Consider potential for fraud
controls.summary: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.

controls.title: Identify and assess changes
controls.summary: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact internal control.

controls.title: Perform ongoing and separate evaluations
controls.summary: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations of internal control.

controls.title: Evaluate and communicate deficiencies
controls.summary: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies in a timely manner.

controls.title: Select and develop control activities
controls.summary: The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.

controls.title: Select and develop technology controls
controls.summary: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.
evidenceExamples: Automated security controls in the pipeline

controls.title: Deploy controls through policies and procedures
controls.summary: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures.

controls.title: Implement logical access security
controls.summary: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures to protect information assets.
implementationChecklist: Encrypt data at rest and in transit

controls.title: Manage credentials and registration
controls.summary: The entity registers and authorizes new users, and manages credentials and authentication.

controls.title: Authorize access based on least privilege
controls.summary: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access based on roles and least privilege.

controls.title: Restrict physical access
controls.summary: The entity restricts physical access to facilities and protected information assets.

controls.title: Protect against unauthorized disposal
controls.summary: The entity discontinues logical and physical protections over assets only after data is removed.

controls.title: Restrict access at system boundaries
controls.summary: The entity implements controls to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.

controls.title: Protect information during transmission and movement
controls.summary: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information and protects it during transit.

controls.title: Prevent and detect unauthorized or malicious software
controls.summary: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon unauthorized or malicious software.

controls.title: Detect vulnerabilities and monitor configuration
controls.summary: The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations and susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Monitor system components for anomalies
controls.summary: The entity monitors system components and the operation of controls for anomalies indicative of security events.

controls.title: Evaluate security events
controls.summary: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they could result in a failure to meet objectives.

controls.title: Respond to security incidents
controls.summary: The entity responds to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident-response program.

controls.title: Recover from security incidents
controls.summary: The entity identifies, develops, and implements activities to recover from security incidents.

controls.title: Manage changes to infrastructure and software
controls.summary: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures.
implementationChecklist: Test changes for security before release

controls.title: Identify and mitigate business risk
controls.summary: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk-mitigation activities for risks arising from potential disruptions.

controls.title: Manage vendor and business partner risk
controls.summary: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners, including their software components.

controls.title: Maintain and monitor capacity
controls.summary: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity to manage availability.

controls.title: Implement recovery and backup
controls.summary: The entity authorizes, designs, and implements environmental protections, backup, and recovery to meet availability objectives.

controls.title: Ensure processing completeness and accuracy
controls.summary: The entity implements controls over inputs, processing, and outputs to meet processing integrity objectives.
